reported.title: RPM line format wrong (lowercase, space after colon)
reported.description: printRpm at lines 45-46 emits "rpm: " followed by the value, but the spec requires `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon. The measured evidence shows no serial line matched /^RPM:[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s across 21 scenarios, so the required line is never produced. No serial line matched /^RPM:[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Printed rpm never parsable so value cannot be verified
reported.description: Because printRpm (lines 45-46) prints "rpm: " instead of "RPM:", the value pattern /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ never matches; measured evidence reports no parsable serial value in 8.00 s. The scaling at line 21 (raw * 5000/1023) is also suspect for 1 mV/rpm, but the format failure alone prevents any comparison. No serial line matched /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A5.

reported.title: D9 fails to light at over-speed due to mute handling and sampling
reported.description: updateWarn (lines 38-40) only runs every 50 ms inside the sample branch and reads mute directly, so a released mute at 2100 rpm left D9 not HIGH for 2002 ms (measured). The lamp state also depends on the raw noisy reading with no hysteresis, causing wrong-state intervals up to 4048 ms. D9 was in the wrong state for 2101 ms across 2 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D9 was not HIGH for 2002 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: D9 chatters on noisy threshold readings
reported.description: updateWarn uses a bare `v >= WARN_RPM` comparison (line 39) on an unfiltered analogRead (line 20), so noise around 2000 mV toggles D9 every sample. Measured evidence shows D9 not LOW for 50-150 ms intervals across 14 scenarios, e.g. 3353 ms wrong across 37 intervals. D9 was in the wrong state for 3353 ms across 37 interval(s), first at 900 ms: D9 was not LOW for 50 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Tach input on A5 at 1 mV per rpm; over-speed lamp on D9; mute on D3 (pull-up).
- Print `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon once per second (1000 ms ±120 ms).
- Printed rpm must stay within ±50 of the injected tach value.
- Light D9 when rpm is at or above 2000 while mute is released.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D9 OFF regardless of rpm.
- Each second also print `spindle min=<n> max=<n>` after the RPM line.
